item.content:encoded:
I really like the characterizations of Iris and Adrian in this. On one hand Adrian comes across as something of a coward (or at least not a hero). He obviously considers what the Foundation is doing to Iris wrong and clearly knows Iris well and trusts that she will save him and yet does little to help her.

Iris seems kind-of heroic. (compassionate self-sacrificing, looks out for her friends etc…)

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I am conflicted about this tale. The resurrection cannon does feature the revival of old characters and whatnot, but usually that uses old tales as a basis for the new ones, flowering off in a different direction and exploring the aftershocks years later. Kondraki's destruction of site 19 is already set in stone. However, this story is more of a rehash/rewrite over a new addition, and takes place before/during the Kondraki+682's rampage. It is certainly competently written, but no vote for now.

item.content:encoded:
While I'm glad to see work being done on this canon, I felt like this tale was, for the most part, things we've seen mentioned before, sometimes several times before.

Given that this is the first part to a five part flashback episode to an incident we've seen mentioned before… I'll just hope for the best.

P.S. Now my in-progress tale drafts about a character named Adrian are gonna look all derivative and stuff.

EDIT: Also, thank you for finally confirming that Agent AA has at least an average-sized penis. I can finally get some sleep at night.
